title: MyReturnType
description:
Implement `MyReturnType<T>` — a conditional type that extracts the return type of a function type `T` — without using the built-in `ReturnType<T>`.

**Example:**
```ts
type A = MyReturnType<() => number>          // number
type B = MyReturnType<(s: string) => boolean> // boolean
type C = MyReturnType<() => { id: number }>  // { id: number }
```
starter_code: export type MyReturnType<T extends (...args: any) => any> = // your type here
solution: export type MyReturnType<T extends (...args: any) => any> = T extends (...args: any) => infer R ? R : never;
ai_context: Common mistake: trying to use `T['return']` or accessing return type without `infer`. The `infer R` keyword inside a conditional type is the only way to capture and name the return type.
